name: Skippy
short: An ancient otter wizard powered by Gemini.
description: A Redbot cog to interact with the Gemini API, embodying Skippy, a wise and world-weary otter wizard, with dynamic moods and long-term memory via MySQL.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores user IDs, guild IDs, and conversation history for the purpose of maintaining context and personalized responses. It also stores user-specific facts in a MySQL database for long-term memory. All data can be deleted upon user request.
